summary: Patient missed appointment due to not receiving a reminder message and forgetting.
recommended_action: Ensure reminder messages are sent reliably to patients.

summary: Patient missed due to long distance and lack of transport, finding the clinic too far for routine visits.
recommended_action: Offer telemedicine options or suggest a closer clinic location for routine check-ups.

summary: Patient missed due to high consultation fee; inquired about follow-up discounts.
recommended_action: Review consultation fee structure and consider discount options for follow-up visits.

summary: Patient missed due to high fever and body ache on the appointment day.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment once the patient has recovered.

summary: Patient missed due to an urgent work meeting and requested an evening slot for future appointments.
recommended_action: Offer evening appointment slots to accommodate patients with work commitments.

summary: Patient forgot appointment, stating no SMS reminder was received. Wishes to rebook.
recommended_action: Verify patient's contact details and reminder preferences for future appointments.

summary: Patient missed due to city bus strike and lack of auto availability, highlighting transport issues.
recommended_action: Offer telemedicine options or provide transport assistance for patients in affected areas.

summary: Patient's phone was switched off; unable to determine reason for missed appointment.
recommended_action: Attempt to contact the patient via alternative methods if available, or send an SMS.

summary: Patient missed due to work shift change; prefers Saturday appointments.
recommended_action: Offer Saturday appointments and confirm availability before scheduling.
